Dean's Full Ride Scholarship

A full ride scholarship for overseas scholars covering comprehensive costs of attendance.

Tuition is covered at $55,000 per year.

Housing is provided at $12,000 per year.

Meal plan and board is provided at $7,000 per year.

Health insurance coverage is provided at $3,500 per year.

Travel and flight allowance is $2,000 one-time upon initial matriculation.
